comparator.name: Health Sciences (Gezondheidswetenschappen)
comparator.academicYear: Fall 2026 entry; 2026–27 OER during phased rollout of the 2025–26 curriculum revision
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted OER, article 11.3, specifies ten compulsory first-year 6-EC units and eight second-year 6-EC units; article 11.4 requires one 6-EC choice in second-year period 5 from Mental Health, Planetary Health, or Diversity and Equity and one 6-EC choice in period 6 from Management van Innovaties, Voedingsleer en Onderzoek, or Implementatieonderzoek. Article 12.1 establishes at least 30 EC in the third-year minor/free-choice semester. Thus 150 EC of year-one, year-two and third-year free-choice structure is securely credit-bearing. The currently taught third-year table lists Epidemiologie & Biostatistiek III at 6 EC and Bachelorstage (GZW) at 18 EC, with other 6-EC year-three electives, but the OER also says the old curriculum is being phased out from 2025–26. Its new-cohort prerequisite section explicitly names 'Methodologie 5: zelf onderzoek doen' with course code still unknown. The prospective programme page says the new third year includes a minor, a three-month research placement and bachelor thesis, and names 'De gezondheidswetenschapper als professional', while the current OER gives no new-cohort credit allocation for those latter elements. Treating the current old-cohort third-year 24 EC as the complete 2026 entrant's future 30 EC would miss at least 6 EC and potentially misrepresent the new methods, professional and thesis work. The study guide confirms Dutch instruction and 180 EC but the accessible programme summary provides no future-year component table.

exception.reason: The new curriculum was phased in from 2025–26. For a Fall 2026 entrant, the 2026–27 OER securely specifies 120 EC across the first two years and at least 30 EC of third-year free choice, but its current third-year table (6 EC Epidemiologie & Biostatistiek III and 18 EC Bachelorstage) does not establish the full future new-cohort route. The same OER names Methodologie 5 for the new cohort with its code still unknown, while the prospective page describes professional work, research placement and bachelor thesis without applicable component credits. Even adding the two listed old-cohort third-year courses to the supported 150 EC reaches only 174 EC. Assigning the missing credits to a third-year elective, methodology, professional module or thesis by subtraction would invent the formal pathway.
exception.curriculumContext: The normalized target is the Dutch-taught VU 180-EC Gezondheidswetenschappen bachelor. Its prospective focus is population health, health inequity, behaviour, environment, health systems, prevention and multidisciplinary research; UCR health, social-science and policy courses appear potentially relevant, so this exception is about the unresolved external third-year structure rather than a concluded absence of any UCR match. Revisit with the applicable new-cohort year-three OER/degree plan, including the Methodologie 5 and stage/thesis/professional credit allocation.
